items.summary: 阶跃星辰发布其推理优化型模型Step 3.7 Flash。该模型为196B MoE架构，从设计之初就专注于推理效率。其采用多矩阵分解注意力机制，使KV-cache成本仅为DeepSeek模型的约22%；同时通过注意力与FFN解耦技术，实现了硬件优化的高效服务。该模型已通过Fireworks AI提供，采用Apache 2.0许可，并可用于构建智能体应用。

items.name: Aaron Levie
items.bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
items.text: This is effectively the #1 problem for AI agents in the enterprise. As we go from agentic coding (where a large amount of context is in the code base, and users are technical enough to get the rest to the agent easily) to a world of knowledge work agents, the context problem beco
items.textZh: 这基本上是 AI agent 在企业里的头号问题。我们正从 agentic coding（大量上下文就在 codebase 里，用户也够技术，能把剩下的喂给 agent）走向 knowledge work agent 的时代，context 问题变得尖锐得多。我们在 Box 每天都看到这种情况：现有的数字化知识往往散落在跟 agent 不兼容的老系统里，权限控制也跟真实工作流对不上，这些都是 agent 拿到所需 context 的巨大障碍。这些东西都得迁移到现代的、安全的云环境里。但另一方面，公司常常连一些关键 context 都还没沉淀和数字化——决策、流程、工作方式都活在人的脑子里、活在"江湖经验"里，需要先转成非结构化数据，agent 才能用。这其实是应用层 AI 公司最大的杠杆点之一——他们可以专门把 agent 需要的信息和领域专业知识喂进去。这也是 FDE 和新一代系统集成商现在能做起来的原因。把这件事搞明白的公司，未来才能真正吃到 AI 的红利。

podcast.title: OpenAI's Yann Dubois: Why AI Progress Suddenly Feels Real

zh.lead: 表面故事是“Meta 的 AI support 出了个离谱小 bug”。真正能卖给 builder 的信号更尖锐：The newest Instagram "exploit" is the goofiest I've seen 引发 323 条讨论：一个支持 AI 把重置码发到了攻击者控制的邮箱，绕过 2FA，再通过本该平平无奇的 account recovery 流程把账号交了出去。

build.title: Recovery Flow Receipt
build.oneLiner: 面向 SaaS 和支持团队的账号恢复审计：检查 password reset、客服脚本或 AI 辅助 helpdesk 动作是否会把验证码发到错误地址、绕过 2FA 或改变账号所有权。它的证据来自 Instagram 接管流程引发的 323 条讨论，以及评论者对高权限客服软件的具体抱怨。

signals: 账号恢复成了最紧迫的 AI 边界：Instagram 的支持流程引发 323 条讨论，因为重置码可以被发到任意邮箱，而 2FA 没能保护受害者。
依赖安装在另一次供应链冲击后继续危险：Malicious npm packages detected across Red Hat Cloud Services 围绕发布延迟、sandboxed installs 和密钥暴露引发 410 条讨论。
AI 产品正在进入普通工作界面：Product Hunt 上的 Mina Meeting Assistant、SocialEcho 2.0、使用 Model Context Protocol 连接器标准的 Databox MCP，以及 Dune Keypad，都围绕会议、数据、social workflows 和桌面控制引发了活跃讨论。

en.lead: The obvious story is "Meta had a silly AI support bug." The sellable builder signal is sharper: The newest Instagram "exploit" is the goofiest I've seen drew 323 comments after a support AI sent reset codes to an attacker-controlled email, bypassed 2FA, and handed over accounts through a recovery flow that should have been boring.

build.title: Recovery Flow Receipt
build.oneLiner: an account-recovery audit for SaaS and support teams that shows whether password resets, support scripts, or AI-assisted helpdesk actions can send codes to the wrong address, bypass 2FA, or change account ownership, backed by 323 comments on the Instagram takeover flow and concrete reviewer complaints about privileged support software.

signals: Account recovery became the most urgent AI boundary: Instagram's support flow drew 323 comments because a reset code could be sent to an arbitrary email and 2FA did not save the victim.

Dependency installs stayed dangerous after another supply-chain hit: Malicious npm packages detected across Red Hat Cloud Services drew 410 comments around release delays, sandboxed installs, and secret exposure.

AI products are entering ordinary work surfaces: Product Hunt launches such as Mina Meeting Assistant, SocialEcho 2.0, Databox MCP using the Model Context Protocol connector standard, and Dune Keypad each drew active discussion around meetings, data, social workflows, and desktop control.
